GOAL: orient in repo before proposing ideas.
READ: workspace listing and repo root.
OBSERVED: (pending)
OPEN: need to know existing RQ-VAE / Stage3 code.

FINAL ANSWER delivered (3 ideas, full text in the assistant reply; this progress file cannot hold >4000 chars). Summary:
1. BRANCHCURV-SID: per-code negative curvature kappa_k = k0*exp(H_k-Hbar) derived from training successor-branching entropy H_k of items hard-assigned to code k; enters RQ-VAE assignment logits l_ik=-d_{kappa_k}(u_i,e_k)^2/tau; EMA refresh, clamp [0.25k0,4k0], freeze after epoch 500. Behaviour-off: H_k=Hbar; geometry-off: Euclidean distance.
2. SUCC-TAN-RQ: successor tangent t_i = mean_j(log_0 u_j - log_0 u_i) over training successors; base shift s_i=exp_0(log_0 u_i + eta t_i), eta=d_code/median||t_i|| measured; curved residual chain b^{l+1}=exp_{e_c}(log_{e_c} b^l - log_{e_c} e_c), codes argmin d_k, u_hat=exp_0(sum log_0 e_c); loss d(u,u_hat)^2+d(s,u_hat)^2. Behaviour-off: eta=0; geometry-off: Euclidean.
3. GEOPFX-SID: training transition pairs (i,j) pull shared prefix anchor g_ij=exp_0(sum_{m<=LCP} log_0 e_c) onto hyperbolic geodesic gamma(u_i,u_j); L_geo = w_ij * dist_k(g,gamma)^2 / d_k(u_i,u_j)^2, 2048 pairs/step, 12 golden-section steps. Behaviour-off: no edges/term; geometry-off: Euclidean segment distance.
All training-only, precomputed from train split, no val/test leakage; one run each; costs +5% to +2x quantizer, no extra epochs; target Stage3 Recall@10 > 0.065.
